Icather/dsh-clean-desktop-shell.body:
# dsh-clean-desktop-shell

**Clean desktop shell for DeepSeek Harness (DSH plugin form)**

It does one thing: it adds a clean desktop window layer to an already configured DSH Web instance, with a system tray, single-instance behavior, and use like a regular app. No frosted glass, no flashy materials. **Clean**.

[English](https://github.com/Icather/dsh-clean-desktop-shell/blob/HEAD/README.en.md) · [中文](https://github.com/Icather/dsh-clean-desktop-shell/blob/HEAD/README.md)

## What is this

`dsh-clean-desktop-shell` is a **DSH plugin-form** clean desktop shell. It wraps an already running DSH Web instance (default `http://127.0.0.1:3080`) in a native desktop window, with a system tray and single-instance behavior, so it can be used like a regular desktop app. **No visual changes**: no frosted glass, no UI modifications. It is purely a "window shell".

The main difference from other desktop solutions in the ecosystem:

| | Other desktop solutions (e.g., the dsh-desktop series) | This plugin |
|:--|:--|:--|
| **Form** | Standalone Electron app with its own profile | **DSH plugin**, mounted into the existing profile |
| **Profile** | New desktop profile; plugins/config must be reinstalled | **Reuses the existing web profile**, zero migration |
| **Visual changes** | Custom-drawn title bar / frosted glass, etc. | **Zero changes**, pure window shell |
| **Upstream tracking** | Fixed version | **Adapted to DSH 0.1.2 BrowserAuth** (automatic authentication on cold start; does not take over or kill external backends) |

## Core highlights

**① Launch DSH in one click, like opening a desktop app**

No terminal, no commands to remember. **Double-click the desktop shortcut and the DSH window appears immediately**, as naturally as launching any ordinary software:

- The installer automatically creates a desktop shortcut. In plugin form, the first run asks, and the tray's "Create desktop shortcut" option rebuilds it in one click.
- Double-clicking opens the window immediately. The window does not wait for the backend and shows no startup wait.
- Single instance: repeated double-clicks only focus the existing window and never open a second shell.

**② Live backend liveness monitoring · quick manual and self-directed start/stop**

The tray **shows backend status in real time** (running / starting / not running / error) and provides one-click start/stop:

- **Response monitoring**: keeps the 1,500 ms probe timeout. A failed response does not mean the process has exited. For brief or sustained failures, the loaded page is kept and only a connection notice is shown.
- **Original-page reconnect**: combines HTTP and client connection state and restores sync through the client's own connection service, without automatic reload. Automatic retries keep the 4-second probe cadence; manual retries share the duplicate-request guard. …

# Iterglow

**Open-source A/B testing and experimentation platform**

Iterglow is a platform that splits a service's features by user, delivers them, collects actual exposures and behavior, and compares the results. You can define user identifiers, events, and target metrics for each service and connect them through an SDK.

chinjiaqing/jc-daily-report.description: Daily football match analysis for Jingcai (China sports lottery), interpreting odds movements; Football lottery (足彩)
chinjiaqing/jc-daily-report.body:
# ⚽ Football Signal Radar · Daily Signal Report

> **Set emotions aside, watch only the signals.**
> Cross-validation of market movements across three channels. No bets on low odds, no bets when signals are unclear. Runs automatically before matches and settles automatically after.

## 🚀 Online Site

- **[https://chinjiaqing.github.io/jc-daily-report/](https://chinjiaqing.github.io/jc-daily-report/)**
- Updates automatically every hour, historical dates archived, look back anytime
- Covers **500~1300+** matches per day (full Jingcai/Asian handicap coverage), automatically flags signals and bets

---

## The Detours We Bypassed

We tried **models**: piled up a room full of parameters. Looking back, the model just recited prices the market had already set. More parameters couldn't produce anything new.

We tried **studying market makers**: guessing at the bookmakers' moves, and the more we guessed, the more it looked like paranoid delusion. In the end we realized: guessing at the house is less useful than watching the price.

We also tried **AI predictions**: injuries, motivation, form. Each sounded convincing, and each had already been priced into the odds long before. However noisy it got, the market didn't buy it.

With the detours behind us, one plain truth remains:

> **Where the money goes, the handicap talks.**
> But people watching the lines get carried away easily: chasing favorites, fearing upsets, shaky hands near kickoff. You can tell at a glance when emotion is doing the trading.

So we hand both "watching" and "buying" to the machine, and keep only one thing for the human: **discipline**.

## Three Informants, One Referee

**1X2 (European odds)** watches market-wide odds movements: who's being abandoned collectively, who's quietly defending, whether the draw line has been given up. This is the closest informant.

**Asian handicap** watches the line and water levels: sudden pivots near kickoff, sniping on the favored side. Money thrown down in real cash is more reliable than what people say.

**Over/Under** watches the total goals line. Once a goal-rich setup appears, the goal count has often already been decided.

Each of the three informants brings its own news. When the news agrees, the referee dares to call it. **Matches where they disagree (1X2 and Asian handicap fighting each other) are simply left alone.** If the informants are already arguing, there's no reason to bet.

## Discipline Matters More Than Vision

Once the direction is set, what remains is all discipline:

- **No bets on low odds**: single-pick odds under 1.5, or double-pick odds discounted below 1.3. No matter how good the signal, don't buy. At odds that low, even a win barely pays.
- **No bets without a clear signal**: no signal, conflicting signals, or a vague direction means always wait. Missing a bet costs nothing; a bad bet loses money.
- **Quality determines stake**: the stronger the signal, the larger the stake (1/2/4 units). No all-in gambling.
- **Automatic betting 15 minutes before kickoff, automatic settlement when results come in**: no shaky hands in the moment, no urge to double down after a win or chase losses after a defeat.

---

## ⚠️ Disclaimer

This project is for data research only and does not constitute any purchase advice. Buy lottery tickets only at licensed physical retail outlets. Persons under 18 may not participate.

# speed-github

A tool to solve the problem of slow loading and downloading speed of GitHub in the country.

## Reason for slow speed

CDN, Content Distribute Network, can be literally translated into content distribution network. CDN solves the problem of how to quickly and reliably deliver data from the source site to users.

When users obtain data, they do not need to obtain it directly from the source site. Through CDN's distribution of data, users can obtain data from a better server, thereby achieving fast access and reducing the load pressure on the source site.

For some reasons, Github is restricted in China. The main method is`DNS pollution`, which is to inject the wrong IP address of Github into the DNS server, thereby affecting user access.

## Solution

Resolve the GitHub-related domain name into the correct IP address, and then fill it into the local host file. When users visit GitHub, they will no longer resolve the IP address to the DNS server, but use the correct local IP address, which will not be affected by DNS…

molimao/iota.body:
# IOTA Watch

An open-source, five-language, multi-project monitoring dashboard centered on **IOTA Train at Home**. It supports IOTA, XID / MMM, Quantus, fly.ai, Nosana, Gonka, Akash, io.net, Vast.ai and Golem; each project's inputs, cycles, and data coverage are described separately.

**[Official site](https://iotahome.site) · [My Devices](https://iotahome.site/zh/devices) · [IOTA Lookup](https://iotahome.site/zh/app) · [Network Status](https://iotahome.site/zh/network) · [Blog](https://iotahome.site/zh/blog) · [English](https://iotahome.site/en)**

IOTA Watch is an independent MIT-licensed monitor in English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean and Japanese. IOTA Train at Home (Macrocosmos / Bittensor SN9) is the core project, with ten project pages covering training, mining and compute. Tool pages query records; separate tutorials explain identifiers, fields and troubleshooting. Public projects use public identifiers; io.net and Vast.ai require account connections with read credentials. Those two integrations have mocked validation; real-account validation remains pending.

The screenshot shows miner distribution and network capacity; the figures are official data as of when the screenshot was taken.

## Features

- **Multi-device monitoring**: add, name, and view devices by public Miner ID, filtering by contributing, waiting for tasks, needs checking, and pending confirmation.
- **Earnings records**: today, cumulative, paid, pending payment, frozen, and minimum payment amounts; also shows USD valuations with source and timestamp.
- **Training history**: view training tokens, throughput, and cumulative tokens by day, week, or month; missing data is left as gaps.
- **Network visualization**: regional distribution donut chart, miner count rankings, slot occupancy, task progress, and tier overview.

ttf248/local-gallery.body:
# Local Gallery

Local Gallery is a gallery for photos, comics, and videos that runs on your own machine. The Go backend reads the configured directories directly, and the browser provides the interface. Application state is stored in local JSON files, so no database is required. Media analysis and semantic search both run locally; the semantic search model must be downloaded separately the first time.

For collaboration rules, see [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/ttf248/local-gallery/blob/HEAD/AGENTS.md).

## Core Features

| Workspace | Main features |
| --- | --- |
| Photos | Multiple directories merged into one media library; browse by album, collection, tag, year, and GPS location. The Footprints page has a header strip (time-span filter and whole-library scale), and the main body's right column is a map that clusters photo coordinates into a grid, with trips listed on the left. Chinese semantic search and search by image; photo wall, large-image preview, side-by-side comparison, 'Picks', favorites, and recently viewed. |
| Comics | Standalone works list; single-page, continuous, two-page, and RTL reading; zoom, rotate, table of contents, reading progress restore, unread list, and recently read. |
| Background tasks | Scan progress with cancel; full or incremental jobs for EXIF/GPS, OCR, face analysis, and semantic vectors. The Task Center can start all ready modules in sequence, always shows the waiting queue, filters and clears history, and supports pause, resume, retry of failed items, restart recovery, and daily schedules. On the same page it shows local storage: derived cache usage and cleanup, model weights and artifacts for each analysis module, and relative and absolute local paths. Model tasks force GPU by default and can switch to CPU; when the GPU is unavailable or inference fails, the reason is written to the task record. Before starting, it shows how many images will be processed and the estimated time (incremental and full runs side by side, with time estimated from past task speed). Task records can be expanded to view that task's own artifact directory and usage, and failed images are listed by relative path. |
| Local AI | Chinese-CLIP for Chinese semantic search and similar-image retrieval; RapidOCR for text recognition, with OCR keyword search that can be combined with album, year, GPS, person, favorite, and pick filters; YuNet + SFace for face detection, local feature generation, finding similar photos, and building person candidate albums that can be renamed, merged, split, or hidden. Person analysis is off by default and must be explicitly enabled in the Task Center. |
| Video and media | Native browser playback and Range requests; optional FFmpeg provides video covers, metadata, faststart, H.264/AAC transcoding, and HEIC/HEIF/TIFF conversion. |
| Local management | Media root directory management, derived cache cleanup and rebuild, state backup and restore, light/dark themes, keyboard and touch controls. 'Picks' at the photo level and 'favorites' at the album level are stored separately. |

Photos and comics are two isolated workspaces. Each media root directory must be designated as either photos or comics; comic reading progress does not mix into photo browsing history.

## First Installation and Running

### Using a Release Package

The current main line is the Go + React v2 architecture. When downloading a release package, choose the system and architecture that match v2.x; v1.x belongs to the legacy version…
